name: Jaime Alonso
headline: I build fullstack applications and coordinate AI agent teams, from software architecture and databases to UI/UX and production monitoring.

points: Developed Welloop, a PWA with more than 600 active users (production data, November 2026), with ongoing patches and updates using CI/CD and a Docker development environment.
Built an AI-native platform with security measures, payments, external integrations, notifications, team management (events and communications), and role and user management.
Automated core development flows with AI agent tools and evaluation cycles.
Developed and published the mobile app for MIRTO, a luxury clothing brand, integrated with Shopify and the company's services, for Android and iOS.
Developed the internal business operations application (analytics, notifications, factory operations, product stock and other external integrations).
Developed a Shopify plugin to synchronise catalogs between MIRTO's international stores.

education.title: Higher Technician in Cross-Platform Software Development
